NATIONAL WATER SUPPLY AND DRAINAGE BOARD ACT, No. 02 OF 1974
Order under Section 92

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No.02 of 1974,I, Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply, and Higher Education, do hereby approve the acquisition ofthe land, described in the following Schedule, as it is required by the said board, for construction of Reservior with thecapacity of 225 cubic meters and pump house under Greater Galle Stage III Water Supply Project.

RAUFF HAKEEM,Minister of City Planning,Water Supply and Higher Education.Ministry of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education,No. 35, “Lakdiya Medura”,New Parliament Road,Pelawatta, Battaramulla,29th August, 2019.5/2/2/1475.
